name: Original Tamriel pathgrid: ordinary overland travel from Chorrol to Hackdirt

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade::ref=0x0280fa::side=south
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=hackdirt-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5
